## Describe the problem
Briefly describe the issue you are experiencing. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened instead: provide a clear and concise description of the issue(s). Remember, this is **not** a place to ask questions. We have `slack` for this purpose 🤓.
```
Insert description here
```

## Urgency
Describe here the urgency from `1 - 10` (1 is low, 10 is high) and your deadline date ⏳. The bioinformatics team takes this into accound when discussing the tasks for the sprint 😉.
```
Deadline date:
Urgency from 1 - 10:
```

## Screenshots
Please provide screenshots 🖼️ and the error message that occurred to make the lives of the bioinformatics team easier 😪.

## Data files
A list of relevant files for this issue will help people navigate the project and offer some clues 🔍 about where to start. The input files need to be included in this 🐛 report (drag and drop the relevant files here or create a .zip archive if the extension is not allowed). Alternatively, a full path to the  folder with the content needs to be given. 

## System information
- R version _(e.g. `4.1.2 (2021-11-01) -- "Bird Hippie"`)_
- Version of pipeline _(e.g. `1.1`, `1.5`, `1.8.2`)_
- Add the content of the session information from R (run `sessionInfo()` in the R terminal)
